feeds.title: Living Lutheran
feeds.description: Living Lutheran is your source for news, reflections and stories from the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America (ELCA) and its local and global companions. We cover religious news and social issues, congregational life, global and domestic mission, family matters, spiritual practices and resources, and more.

feeds.title: Evangelical Lutheran Church in America Blog
feeds.description: The Evangelical Lutheran Church in America (ELCA) is one of the largest Christian denominations in the United States. We are the church that shares a living, daring confidence in God's grace. Liberated by our faith, we embrace you as a whole person--questions, complexities and all. Join us as we do God's work in Christ's name for the life of the world.

feeds.title: Women of the ELCA Blog
feeds.description: Women of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America gather for service study advocacy fellowship learn about justice discipleship stewardship. We commit ourselves to grow in faith, affirm our gifts, support one another in our callings, engage in ministry and action, and promote healing and wholeness in the church, the society, and the world.

feeds.title: Northern Texas Northern Louisiana Synod, ELCA
feeds.description: The Northern Texas-Northern Louisiana Synod is committed to developing leadership to proclaim the gospel of Jesus Christ, growing our congregations, and welcoming all people to share in this life-giving message of hope, inclusion, and justice.

feeds.title: Pastoral Meanderings
feeds.description: I am Pastor Peters. I have been a Lutheran Pastor for more than 37 years, serving in the Lutheran Church Missouri Synod, and the Pastor of Grace Lutheran Church in Clarksville, TN, in my 25th year here. I have a lot of thoughts and this place is where you meet some of those meandering thoughts from this pastoral mind.

feeds.title: Back To Luther
feeds.description: Back To Luther and the old (German) Missouri Synod. Below are thoughts, confessions, quotations from a Missouri Synod Lutheran who came back to his old faith... and found more treasures than he knew existed in the training of his youth.

feeds.title: Weedon's Blog
feeds.description: Homilies, Musings, and What-not from a Lutheran Chaplain

feeds.title: A Collection of Prayers
feeds.description: A Collection of Prayers collects the best prayers of the past and present of Christendom.

feeds.title: International Lutheran Council
feeds.description: The ILC is a worldwide association of established confessional Lutheran church bodies that proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ on the basis of an unconditional commitment to the Holy Scriptures as the inspired and infallible Word of God and to the Lutheran Confessions contained in the Book of Concord as the true and faithful exposition of the Word of God.

feeds.title: Preachrblog
feeds.description: I am Tom. I am an Associate Pastor at Messiah Lutheran Church, Keller, Texas. Former Missionary to Singapore.

feeds.title: Esgetology
feeds.description: Weelcome! I am the pastor at Immanuel Evangelical-Lutheran Church in Alexandria, Virginia. You will find here some of my sermons, along with theological ideas and quotations.

feeds.title: Redeemer Lutheran Church » News
feeds.description: Redeemer Lutheran Church, Fort Wayne, is a congregation of the Lutheran Church—Missouri Synod (LCMS) and is committed to the doctrine of the Lutheran Church. We are devoted to liturgical worship, to catechesis, and to the centrality of the Holy Communion and other Sacraments in the life of the Christian.

feeds.title: Canadian Lutheran
feeds.description: The national magazine of Lutheran Church Canada.

feeds.title: First Lutheran Church
feeds.description: Welcome to First Lutheran Church. We live, serve, reach out, and worship in the name of Jesus Christ. We give God's Word in Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sinners, and teach how to share the good news while serving our neighbors' needs, and building up the community of faith.

feeds.title: Pastor Mattrichard
feeds.description: Pastor Richard, serving St. Paul's Lutheran Church since 2018, brings a wealth of experience from ministries across several states. With degrees from Concordia Seminary and Lutheran Brethren Seminary, he's deeply rooted in theology. Married to Serenity, they nurture three children. Alongside pastoral duties, he finds solace in carpentry, knife collecting, archery coaching, and writing. His PM Notes ministry aims to evangelize Moral Therapeutic Deists, comfort Post-Evangelicals, and fortify Monergists.

feeds.title: NC Synod ELCA
feeds.description: NC Synod Events and more Congregations in Call Process Donate or send mission support Synod Facts Congregations Baptized Members Rostered Ministers Agencies & Institutions.

feeds.title: Augustana Lutheran Church of Hyde Park Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Augustana Lutheran Church of Hyde Park. Augustana is a community that worships, sings, plays, learns, creates, proclaims, builds community and works for justice. Bringing people into relationship with Jesus Christ through Word and sacrament, service and fellowship.

feeds.title: First Lutheran Church
feeds.description: At First Lutheran, we are a community of disciples of Jesus Christ working for the transformation of the world. Throughout our history, we have remained committed to drawing on our Lutheran (ELCA) tradition of using meaningful worship, content-rich learning and warm hospitality to care well for our congregation, the surrounding community and the world.

feeds.title: Surburg's blog
feeds.description: Mark Surburg is pastor at Good Shepherd Lutheran Church, Marion, IL, a congregation of the Lutheran Church - Missouri Synod. This is a blog about Lutheran theology and practice, and current events that impact the life of the Church.

feeds.title: Sheridan Lutheran Church News
feeds.description: Sheridan Lutheran (ELCA) is a community of Christ's faithful followers in Lincoln, Neb. called by God to love deeply, grow spiritually and share abundantly. Our community strives to live our core values of love, faith, hope, humility and compassion through practical ways in ordinary everyday life.

feeds.title: Living Word - The Lutheran Church Missouri Synod Blog
feeds.description: Living Word Lutheran Church, in Galena, Ohio, is part of the Lutheran Church Missouri Synod. We are committed to worship, growth, serving, and inviting. Read Paster Derrick's blog for updates on the latest sermon series, Music Monday posts, inspiration, and information about things going on at Living Word.

feeds.title: Meet, Write, & Salutary
feeds.description: The 'Meet, Write, and Salutary' blog encourages Lutherans to write. At the same time, maybe this website is better understood as a reading, writing, and resources place.

feeds.title: Liberation Theology Lutheran
feeds.description: I'm a lifelong Lutheran, and although I'm aware of some of the problems with Liberation Theology, it has spoken to me for much of my adolescent and adult life. All of the thoughts on this blog are mine, and I don't intend to speak for any other Lutherans or Liberation Theologians.

feeds.title: Lutheran Ladies Connection
feeds.description: The Lutheran Ladies Connection blog was started by the women of St. Paul's Free Lutheran Church in Leitersburg, Maryland. Our blog is not intended to be exclusive: we want other Lutheran ladies to join us in writing for the blog, and we want all Christian women to feel free to send questions, give thoughts and opinions and suggest monthly themes.

feeds.title: First Lutheran Church » Church Blog
feeds.description: First Lutheran Church is a congregation of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America. With roots in the South Sioux City community dating back almost a century, we celebrate a rich tradition of worship and service. As a visible symbol of Christ's presence in the world, we invite others to join us in our adventure of faith.

feeds.title: Our Redeemer's Lutheran Ballard Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is a great place to hear musings from Pastor Kathy, ministry leaders and folks in our community. A Community in the Model of Christ. In the model of Christ, and for the life of the world, we are an inclusive, devoted, caring, spiritual community that accepts challenges, takes risks and grows.

feeds.title: Wittenberg Door Campus Ministry Blog
feeds.description: Wittenberg Door Campus Ministry is a mission of the American Association of Lutheran Churches. We confess that we believe the words of Scripture to be the inspired Word of God and the only infallible rule of faith and practice. We believe that Christ in His Word brings hope and help to hurting people, using his means of grace in Word and Sacrament.

feeds.title: Lutheran Core
feeds.description: The over-arching goal of Lutheran CORE is to be a voice for the Word of God and a shelter for those who cling to this Word in the church. We seek the renewal of Lutheran congregations according to Holy Scripture and the Lutheran Confessions, and we endorse the Common Confession as a summary of Lutheran convictions for our time and place.

feeds.title: Happy Lutheran Blog
feeds.description: Relating Faith to Life, in Love & Hope

feeds.title: Sermons at St. James Gettysburg
feeds.description: St. James is a congregation of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America (ELCA). We respond to God's abundant grace by being hearers, proclaimers and doers of the Word.

feeds.title: Lutheran Mission
feeds.description: I am Richard, the pastor of the Sydney Lutheran Parish. This blog is about exploring, experimenting, sharing and living out ways of bringing the Good News to people of all nations.

feeds.title: Immanuel Lutheran Church
feeds.description: At The Immanuel Lutheran Church, Lutherans are eager to share the Gospel of Jesus Christ and to invite you to share their church as your spiritual home.

feeds.title: St. Stephen's Lutheran Church Blog
feeds.description: St. Stephen's Evangelical Lutheran Church was established in October of 1888. The mission of St. Stephen's Lutheran Church is TO deepen our LOVE for God and for each other; TO INVITE others into the Good News of Jesus Christ; and TO SERVE those in need.

feeds.title: St. Paul Lutheran Church
feeds.description: Welcome to St. Paul Lutheran Church. Responding to God's grace in Christ, we welcome all people, prepare disciples, and live faithfully through worship, spiritual growth, and action.

feeds.title: Dim Lamp/קנה רצוץ לא ישבור
feeds.description: I am, among other things, a sojourner, a sinner-saint, a baptized, life-long learner and follower of Jesus, and a retired Lutheran Pastor.

feeds.title: Lutheran Subject (Schroeder's blog)
feeds.description: I am Thomas Schroeder, a Lutheran pastor serving at Good Shepherd Evangelical Lutheran Church in Novi, Michigan. Sermons, ramblings, and maybe an occasional rant from a Lutheran subject of Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Christian Nature Poetry
feeds.description: A blend of original and existing poetry (from literature & straight from the Bible) that speaks the Christian message through the idioms of nature. Old posts never become 'old news.'

feeds.title: Bethany Lutheran Church
feeds.description: Bethany Lutheran Church is a congregation of the Lutheran Church Missouri Synod. As the people of God gathered together in this place, we have an important mission to proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ to our community, and to perform acts of mercy and service in the world.

feeds.title: St. Andrew's Lutheran Church, Kamloops
feeds.description: A family of followers of Christ, who learn and share the Good News of Salvation making disciples of Jesus Christ. Christian Church. Worship music by Band of Joy

feeds.title: Like a Lutheran
feeds.description: Tales of a Midwest Lutheran on the East Coast.

feeds.title: Musings about Faith
feeds.description: I am S Blake Duncan. I am serving as Pastor of Peace Lutheran Church in Steeleville, Illinois.

feeds.title: St. Andrew's Lutheran Church Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to lift up Jesus in Worship, Education and Service.

feeds.title: Lutheran Heritage Center & Museum Blog
feeds.description: The Lutheran Heritage Center & Museum documents the German immigration to the Perry County, MO area beginning in 1838. Its mission is to document, preserve, and interpret the 1839 German Lutheran Immigration history in Perry County, Missouri.

feeds.title: St. Peter's Lutheran Church Blog
feeds.description: St. Peter's Evangelical Lutheran Church is an inclusive family of faith, unified in Spirit. As members, we are called to worship God, learn and teach God's Word, and serve humanity, near and far.

feeds.title: Resurrection Lutheran Church & School Blog
feeds.description: The Mission of Resurrection Lutheran Church and School is to Love and Obey the Savior, Equip believers for Ministry and Share the Good News of Jesus.

feeds.title: A Lutheran Layman
feeds.description: I am Jeffrey. An Ex-Evangelical-Non-Denom-Christian Turned Confessional Lutheran. A Lutheran Layman is a Confessional Lutheran Christian Blog without all the NONSENSE so common to Christianity today.

feeds.title: Lutheran Forum Blog
feeds.description: An independent theological quarterly for Lutherans and ecumenical friends. Published by the American Lutheran Publicity Bureau.

feeds.title: Father Hollywood
feeds.description: I'm a Lutheran pastor (Missouri Synod) in the New Orleans area.

feeds.title: Pastor Jennifer Preaching
feeds.description: Pastor Jennifer is an ordained minister in the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America (ELCA).

feeds.title: Zion Lutheran Church Blog
feeds.description: Zion Lutheran Church is the oldest church in Elgin west of the Fox River. Founded in 1882, today it is a lively congregation committed to serving in the community, connecting to our neighbors, and joining in doing God's work - in our daily lives individually and together as a congregation.

feeds.title: Grace Lutheran Church
feeds.description: A lutheran blog.

feeds.title: New Joy Lutheran Church » Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: New Joy Lutheran Church is a spirited community called by God to extend a radical welcome, share a generous grace, nurture a transforming faith, and live God's promise.

feeds.title: Lutheran Confessions
feeds.description: Welcome to Lutheran Confessions. Reverend Doctor Clint Schnekloth, pastor at Good Shepherd Lutheran Church, Fayetteville, Arkansas.

feeds.title: Lutheran Campus Ministry Twin Cities Blog
feeds.description: We are a community of curious Christians gathered together by the Holy Spirit and set free to laugh with, love, question, and be in relationship with God and our neighbors. Grounded in Christ, we are guided by the values of hospitality, service, justice, integrity and faith.

feeds.title: The Benedictine Lutheran
feeds.description: I'm a Lutheran pastor with an interest in Benedictine spirituality.

feeds.title: Liturgy, Hymnody, and Pulpit Quarterly Book Review
feeds.description: Critical reviews by Lutheran pastors and church musicians of books and other resources for Christian worship, preaching, and church music from a perspective rooted in Holy Scripture, the Lutheran Confessions and good common sense.

feeds.title: Claimed, gathered and sent
feeds.description: I'm Ivy, a Lutheran seminary student. 'Marked with the cross of Christ forever, we are claimed, gathered, and sent for the sake of the world.'

feeds.title: Trinity Lutheran Church News
feeds.description: Trinity Lutheran Church is an interdependent part of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America and of the Delaware-Maryland Synod of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America. We are a people called by the Holy Spirit and gathered together to be a community of faith centered in baptism, the proclamation and study of the Word, and participation in the Lord's Supper.

feeds.title: Bethany Lutheran Church - Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: Bethany Lutheran Church is a small, friendly, family-oriented ELCA congregation. We are a community sharing the love of Christ through worship, outreach and fellowship. To become a dynamic Christ-centered church that reaches out in our community and world in loving service.

feeds.title: St. Matthew Lutheran Church » Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: St. Matthew Lutheran Church is a Christian family, based in the holy and perfect Word of God the Bible. As a family of believers, under God's Grace, we exist to encourage each other to grow spiritually through the Gospel, foster Christian relationships, and reach out to the changing world with a changeless Christ.

feeds.title: The Scrupe Blog
feeds.description: A Confessional Lutheran blog on the distinction between the Law and the Gospel, and scrupulosity- also known as religious OCD.

feeds.title: St. Luke's Lutheran Church Blog
feeds.description: St. Luke's Lutheran Church strives to be a Christian community that involves all people of God in worship, learning, care, service and witness.

feeds.title: Lutheran Reformation
feeds.description: When the Reformation began in 1517, the Church and culture were soon to change forever. But centuries haven't changed one thing: it's still all about Jesus!

feeds.title: Lutherans For Life Blog
feeds.description: Lutherans For Life (LFL) is so much more than an organization that produces facts and figures and keeps people informed on the latest life related news and political maneuverings. LFL is about speaking the truth of life about Bringing Good News to Life.

feeds.title: Lutheran Church of Hope
feeds.description: Covers Daily Devotions, Family Devotions, Holy Spirit Stories, and Hope History weekly updates. Lutheran Church of Hope is based in West Des Moines, IA. Our mission is to reach out to the world around us and share the everlasting love of Jesus Christ!

feeds.title: Steadfast Lutherans Blog
feeds.description: An international fraternity of confessional Lutheran laymen and pastors, supporting proclamation of Christian doctrine in the new media.

feeds.title: The Lutheran World Federation Blog
feeds.description: We are a global communion of churches in the Lutheran tradition on a common journey of renewal. We strive to put our faith into action within and beyond the communion, and seek God's Word and Spirit to guide us.

feeds.title: Evangelical Lutheran Synod Blog
feeds.description: The Evangelical Lutheran Synod believes and confesses: - The Bible is God's Word, inspired by the Holy Spirit, and therefore without error. It is the only authority for Christian faith, knowledge, and life. - The Bible's primary purpose is to reveal Jesus Christ - God's Son - as the Savior of the world.

feeds.title: St Petri Lutheran Church - Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to St Petri, a local church in the mission community of the Lutheran Church of Australia. We carry the good news of forgiveness and new life on offer to people by God's grace, received through faith in Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Messiah Lutheran Church and School » Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: Messiah Lutheran Church… Preaches the Gospel We believe that our primary purpose is to proclaim the good news that sins are freely forgiven before God through Jesus' sacrificial death on the cross in our place.

feeds.title: Good Shepherd Lutheran Church Blog
feeds.description: Good Shepherd Lutheran Church is a thriving ELCA congregation located in Gaithersburg, MD. We are here to help you on your spiritual journey and offer you God's loving embrace. At Good Shepherd, you will find an energetic, excited, and diverse congregation. Our worship is uplifting, joyous, and multi-generational.

feeds.title: Somerset Hills Lutheran Church Blog
feeds.description: Somerset Hills Lutheran Church is a liturgical and sacramental church. Our worship style includes alternating traditional, blended and contemporary services.
